summary: Iteration 59 (Slack webhook + Enterprise-Lead intake) fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (16/16) passes and — critically — Playwright-driven browser submissions from /hr-suite (Talent Ops CTA + hr-tier-growth-cta) and /enterprise?bundle=talent-ops-bundle inline form all successfully POST to /api/leads/enterprise, receive 200 + real lead_id, and persist to Mongo with correct bundle. Super-admin Enterprise-Leads panel renders, shows amber 'Slack not configured' banner, and status transitions (dropdown -> 'contacted') persist to DB. Slack degradation graceful (slack_delivered=false, no exceptions).
action_items: Minor doc/testid inconsistency: review request referenced [data-testid='hr-tier-enterprise-hr-cta'] but the actual DOM emits [data-testid='hr-tier-enterprise-cta'] (t.testId='hr-tier-enterprise' + '-cta' suffix in HrSuite.jsx). Either the testId or the request text should be aligned; the CTA itself works and persists bundle='hr-enterprise'.
critical_code_review_comments: leads_router.py header comment says 'Rate-limited: 5 requests/hour per IP' but _IP_HOURLY_CAP=50 — comment is stale, cap is 50/hr (correct for corporate NAT). Consider fixing the doc-string to avoid confusion.

Fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task inside the request handler runs in the same event loop but is not awaited — this is intentional (non-blocking Slack/email) and handled well with try/except; no leak observed. OK as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 lead-submit flows persisted to DB; admin panel + status transition verified)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_it59_* pytest rows and test_frontend_* Playwright rows cleaned from enterprise_leads and lead_intake_rate collections after run (30 leads + 30 rate rows purged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 59 shipped clean. The concern that browser POSTs were being intercepted by the sandboxed screenshot Playwright tool was NOT reproducible with the full testing_agent Playwright — all 3 browser-driven lead submits (talent-ops-bundle from /hr-suite CTA, hr-growth from tier CTA, talent-ops-bundle from /enterprise inline) hit /api/leads/enterprise, returned 200 with a real lead_id, and were confirmed in Mongo (correct bundle, status=new, slack_delivered=false, ip_hash present, raw IP absent). Admin panel at /admin?tab=leads renders EnterpriseLeadsPanel, amber slack-not-configured banner shows, status dropdown persists updates (verified status_updated_by=super-admin-root in DB). No further retest required.
rca of the issue: N/A — earlier main-agent screenshot tool did not observe the API hit because that tool captures a single frame and does not stay live long enough for the fire-and-forget async submission to complete. The full testing_agent Playwright with request/response event listeners captured 3 successful POSTs with 200 responses. Root cause was tooling observability, not application behaviour.
